scope.public_source_fetch: Four narrow exact-commit source files resolve PIDsService.create/RecordItem/config; original pinned research otherwise reused.

doi_envelope_resolved.source_chain: PIDsService.create resolves the same draft, writes draft.pids[scheme] from PIDManager.create, commits, then returns configured RecordItem(self, identity, draft, links...). RecordItem dumps service.schema (RDMRecordSchema), including the full draft identity, ownership, metadata, files and pids.

pid_fields.provider: datacite for this managed synthetic DOI
pid_fields.client: optional; if supplied, require the pinned datacite client

doi_envelope_resolved.semantic_limit: The reserve_doi route calls create, whose source documents NEW PID allocation. Returned PID schema has no reservation-status field. Validate allocated DOI identity and later exact stability; do not claim external registration or require an unexposed PID status.
doi_envelope_resolved.branch_rule: Only a wholly absent doi key in a valid pids object may trigger the single allocated-DOI POST. A supplied malformed/empty/external/mismatched DOI fails; it does not trigger fallback allocation. A valid supplied managed DOI skips allocation, leaving the unused POST allowance unused.

required_record_validator: Explicit Accept application/vnd.inveniordm.v1+json for create, DOI allocation, metadata update and draft reads; application/json can return legacy record shape. A legacy-shaped or missing-envelope response stops.

Require id as canonical positive decimal string, not bool/int/freeform coercion. First201 ID must be outside the pinned partial known-ID reject set. After binding, all envelopes require exactly that ID and parent ID. No claim that the reject set is a complete inventory.

Require parent.access.owned_by as an object with user exactly the known canonical owner string, is_published exactly false, status exactly draft and versions.index exactly integer1 (not bool). Reject review/newversion/published states.

Require an aware created timestamp within the explicit permitted clock-skew window around durable create-start/response capture; bind it once. Later envelopes require the same timestamp, not a refreshed creation window. Persist returned ID/created/PID before another mutation.

Require actual metadata/access/files/pids objects, approved source marker/title and full creator/date/resource/access after-image. Do not infer metadata fields from ui display fields. An absent errors field is normal; if present it must be an empty list. Nonempty/malformed errors fail before another write.

Before file initialization, require enabled exactly true, count exactly integer0, total_bytes exactly integer0 and entries exactly empty object. Initial metadata must be the explicitly pinned synthetic create payload, not an assumed empty legacy draft.

After DOI allocation, revalidate the complete same draft envelope; canonical metadata/access/files unchanged, pids.doi valid and durable. A PID-only response fails after the consumed allocation, with no hidden GET or second POST.

Validate DOI syntax and exact stability; do not infer the Sandbox prefix from the repository default10.5281 or fabricate an identifier. Any expected prefix/suffix mapping must be explicit in the approved fixture/grant and grounded in existing provenance.

Every used response link must match the hardconstructed HTTPS Sandbox origin and exact same ID/fixed basename/action path; no redirects, cross-host links, alternate transfer types, slash-containing keys or query credentials. Never follow publish/edit/delete/newversion links.
file_validator: File initialization201 must have exactly one entries-array item with the fixed key and local-transfer semantics; validate content/commit links. Distinguish this array from record files.entries object.

Content PUT200 and commit POST200 must refer to the same key. Completion readback requires status completed, exact byte size/checksum and exact bounded content hash. Pending/failure/incomplete file states cannot count as completion.

Four final readback GETs (draft/list/entry/content) plus the identical completed retry fit8GET; avoid constructor/probe/DOI-confirmation reads. Artifact size must fit the64KiB byte-read cap at offline packet validation.
durability_and_approval: Each of create/DOI/init/commit/metadata/content has a separate durable pre-send allowance and intent, as well as aggregate4POST/2PUT/8GET. Interrupted or ambiguous mutations remain permanently held; never replenish an allowance or recreate.

Exclusive namespace/stage and packet/hash bindings, prior original/fresh failure evidence preserved, 30-minute execution clock written once and never extended. Completed retry reuses the bound ID and issues no writes.

20-second socket timeouts are not a20-second absolute request deadline in requests; document the precise semantics or enforce a wall-time deadline across streamed bodies. The durable30-minute deadline and64KiB cap must remain enforced.

Engineering and dummy offline tests are already authorized. Provider creation needs the separate parent-approved bounded grant because prior create grants are spent and this protocol adds mutations. No blanket migration gate or production adapter is introduced.
offline_contract_tests_required: full DOI allocation envelope + no DOI create response
malformed existing DOI does not allocate
same ID but wrong owner/created/parent/status/metadata after allocation
legacy MIME shape, integer/bool IDs/counts, missing real fields/errors
wrong file keys/transfer/path/links and redirect responses
counter/time/path/state crash windows for all6 possible mutations
8GET and4POST/2PUT exhaustion; completed rerun no writes; no lost-state reset
JSON-escaped credentials/URLs/errors sanitization and oversized/trickled bodies
remaining_limits: Source-supported API contract, not proof of current deployed Sandbox modern write support or bearer scope sufficiency.
No runtime implementation, integration-test or provider-run clearance given by this plan review.
